plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU, PLTU) to zero.
Reduce QQQI to 20% to create cash buffer.
Increase SPY allocation to 30% for stability.
Focus on capital preservation with reduced leverage.
This plan prioritizes safety and lower volatility.
conservative.read: This conservative approach aims for lower, steadier returns, targeting around 1.5% per month. The focus is on preserving capital by significantly reducing leverage and concentrating on stable assets, leading to a lower potential for large drawdowns.

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to below 5% combined.
Reduce underperforming 2x ETFs (MUU, METU, PLTU) to minimal levels.
Buy TSM as a new, high-scoring long setup.
Trim QQQI to 20% to fund new additions.
This plan balances growth with risk management.
balanced.read: This balanced strategy targets approximately 2.5% monthly returns by blending broad market exposure with quality tech and limited leverage. It aims for risk-first growth, with a moderate cash buffer and strict adherence to position size limits to manage potential drawdowns.

plan: Increase leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to 6% each.
Increase underperforming 2x ETFs (MUU, METU, PLTU) to 6% each.
Buy TSM and CRDO as new, high-conviction long setups.
Concentrate exposure in high-potential areas.
This plan aggressively pursues growth through leverage and concentration.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% monthly returns by maximizing leverage and concentrating on high-scoring setups, including leveraged ETFs. Expect significantly higher potential upside but also much larger drawdowns and the risk of rapid losses due to leverage and ETF decay. Strict stop discipline is critical.

plan: Sell all leveraged and high-beta ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU, PLTU, SMH).
Increase QQQI to 30% for enhanced income focus.
Increase SPY to 30% for broad market stability.
Prioritize steady monthly distributions over growth.
This plan aims for low drawdown and reliable income generation.
income.read: This income-focused plan targets around 1% monthly returns by prioritizing yield-generating assets like QQQI and stable broad index funds. It significantly reduces risk and volatility by eliminating leverage and high-beta positions, aiming for capital preservation and consistent distributions, though NAV can still fluctuate.
